text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainy-P~☆★ Don't I smell super good!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I went to get my hair color touched up 
yesterday, and they gave me some treatment 
samples~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Look look, Trainer-pi, smell this too~~!! 
I'm, like, totally obsessed with this 
scent!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After treating her hair with her favorite 
conditioner, Daitaku Helios was in high 
spirits. It seems she had a great day off!
